name: Klaus Goldstein
source:
Likes: Tea and some sweets
Dislikes: Nothing I can think of.
Hobby: Studying about magic-related subjects
Skill: Extreme strict teaching method

"I'll make you pass the trial, so shut up and do what I say so."

Elias: As you can notice by looking at his last name, Klaus is my brother and is 5 years older than me. He is very talented in various fields of study, and I'm proud of him...kind of. Although he's currently enrolled in the academy, he holds a certificate of Elite Magic Knight and serves as the honorable Prefect in the academy.
He's called an Emperor among other students with reverence and for fear of his strong personality. Simply I can describe him in a single word as...intense. His words have never been wrong but...sorry, I can't continue this anymore. I hope you understand. Life is very dear to me.

[Official in-game description (Klaus I, Main Story)]
